title: MKE must contain the latest updates.
check_content:
Check for updates by logging in to the MKE WebUI and Navigating to admin >> Admin Settings >> Upgrade.

In the "Choose MKE Version" section, select the drop-down. The UI will provide a list of available versions.

If an updated version is available in the list, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Note: It is advisable to review the release notes to understand what changes and improvements come with the new version.

Log in to the MKE WebUI and navigate to admin >> Admin Settings >> Upgrade.

In the "Choose MKE Version" section, select the drop-down. Follow the on-screen instructions to start the upgrade.
VulnDiscussion: MKE must stay up to date with the latest patches, service packs, and hot fixes. Not updating MKE will expose the organization to vulnerabilities.
